title: Characteristic parameters of stand alone photovoltaic (PV) systems
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 14244) covers Characteristic parameters of stand alone photovoltaic (PV) systems. This Indian Standard which is identical with lEC Pub 1 1 94 (1 992) Characteristic parameters of stand alone photovoltaic (PV) systems issued by the International Electrotechnicai Commission was adopted by the Systems Sectional Committee (ETD 28) and approval of the Electrotechnicai Division Council. This standard defines the parameters which describe stand alone Photovoltaic Systems and assist in its performance analysis. The text of lEC Standard has been approved as suitable for publication as Indian Standard without deviations. Certain terminology and conventions are however not identical to those used in Indian Standards. Attention is particularly drawn to the following: a) Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard". b) Comma (,) has been used as a decimal marker while in Indian Standards, the current practice is to use a point (.) as the decimal marker. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
